title: A Karen Didn't Want My Baby Brother At The Water Park 🏊
music_credit: Lurking Behind - The Fly Guy Five (royalty free)
lines: A Karen tried to kick my baby brother out of the water park.
Excuse me! Is that a baby? In my pool?
Diapers in the pool? That's disgusting!
Then she grabbed his floatie and popped it with her fingernail.
Oops. Guess he can't swim now.
Max just looked at her. Then he kicked his little legs and splashed her right in the face.
My hair! I just got it done!
So Karen stomped over to our chairs and threw our towels on the ground.
These chairs are for adults only.
Then she marched up to the lifeguard tower and blew the whistle herself.
Whoever's in charge, get down here! That baby needs to leave!
The lifeguard climbed down and slowly took off her sunglasses.
Ma'am, that baby isn't a guest.
Max climbed all the way up the high dive, and did a perfect backflip.
You're banned. You can take the slide out.
Karen went down the big slide, and landed right in the kiddie pool.
The next day, there was a new sign by the pool.
No Karens in the deep end. Signed with one tiny wet footprint.
